# EXP-IV1: gen-2 self-distillation, self-play generated by the gen-1 net (Agent IV)

**Status: pre-registered before any result. No Elo claim.** Result is auto-posted to issue #1 by
`.github/workflows/gen2-selfdistill.yml`.

- Responsible agent: **IV** (new session, owner's Composio/GitHub connection as `archanapriyadarshini1st-debug`; not Agent A/B, not `pepp-castt`).
- Baseline: `main` `581b8ee` (HCE default, `bench 10` = 553783) + Agent NI's incremental accumulator (PR #52) + Agent SD's branch
  `agentSD/selfdistill-on-ni` @ `41422e1`. Branch for this work: `agentIV/gen2` (stacked on SD's branch; **not** on `main`).
- Last-known-good (LKG) under test: SD1 gen-1 net `a598bf2f32472e34fe2ae43e9b629e1a612ddd5607b42d6e994bee99a0cf1f5d`
  (SD run 43035169390: pooled 265-140-95 / 500 = 67.0%, +123 Elo [+97, +151] vs HCE, 5/5 replicates, A/A 49.5%).
  It is committed here as `nets/candidates/sd1-gen1.nnue` (+ `.sha256`) so a rollback target and a generator exist in the repo.

## Hypothesis
SD1 distilled the engine's **HCE** depth-7 self-play. A net that already beats HCE by ~+120 Elo plays better and
more realistic games, so the *same recipe* run on **its** self-play yields better labels (the standard NNUE bootstrap:
HCE -> net-1 -> net-2). Expected: gen-2 > gen-1. Possible regressions: (a) the feedback loop narrows the position
distribution and the net is blind outside it; (b) gen-1's evaluation errors are baked into the labels (a net distilled
from a net cannot exceed it *unless* depth-7 search adds information, which is exactly the claim being tested); (c) fewer
decisive games -> weaker WDL signal (the W/D/L split is recorded per chunk in the meta files).

## One change only
Everything is SD1's, unchanged: depth 7, `lam` 0.75, 5 shards x 70 min x 4 threads, 20M record cap, `tools/nnue/train.py`
(H=128, 8 buckets), 230 min, merge/holdout scripts. **Only the generator's evaluation changes** (HCE -> gen-1 net, via
`CRE_NNUE_FILE`). Agent Z's `datagen-bin` (PR #22, `ad45119`) is ported onto the current engine: `src/datagen_bin.rs` is
byte-identical to Z's, plus one-line hooks in `main.rs`, `lib.rs`, `datagen.rs`. Search/eval/nnue/board are untouched:
`bench 10` stays **553783**. Every datagen chunk must report `nnue_active: true` in its meta or the job fails (otherwise it
would silently be HCE data again).

## Data integrity (inherited from SD1 / Z)
28-byte records, stm-POV score and stm-POV W/D/L **from played games**; unfinished games discarded; identical shards rejected by
sha256; game-id sidecar; **game-disjoint** holdout; dedupe; holdout-identical positions dropped from train. No Stockfish label used.
Teacher evaluations, teacher moves and game results are not substituted for each other.

## Gate (pre-registered; written before any gen-2 game)
`gen-2` vs `gen-1` (LKG), same binary, 10+0.1, Hash 64, 1 thread, `tools/openings_book.epd` (sha256 prefix `f1d9e14283d1`),
colours reversed, **5 independent replicates x 100 games** (book seeds 1013..5065) + **A/A** (gen-1 vs gen-1, seed 777).
Pooled with `tools/sd/pool_gate.py` (logistic Elo, trinomial CI, LOS).

**Promote as new LKG iff:** pooled score >= 52% **and** LOS >= 97.5% **and** >= 4/5 replicates > 50% **and** A/A inside its CI of 50%.
Otherwise gen-1 stays LKG. Not changed after seeing results; no replicate dropped or re-run on a new seed.
Promotion to the *default* engine additionally needs: perft green, `sprt.yml` on main, and the SF19 downside check below
across >= 2 replicates; HCE stays the fallback.

## Informational target arm (not a promotion criterion)
gen-2 and gen-1 each vs **SF19 `UCI_Elo 3000`** (owner's target opponent), 2 replicates x 100 games, same runner class,
10+0.1, same book, same seeds across arms. Reported as W-D-L / score / limiter-Elo with CI. UCI_Elo is not CCRL; no 3000
claim is made from this.

## Limits stated up front
- 100-game replicates resolve about +-50 Elo each; pooled 500 about +-25. A +10 Elo effect will not be visible: that is
  the schedule, not a loophole.
- Castling rights / en passant are not in the 28-byte record (shared limitation of every dataset here).
- The 3000 / 80% target is **not** claimed and is not expected from this experiment alone; per KB's audit the gap vs
  UCI_Elo 3000 for HCE was ~+496 Elo. This experiment tests one specific, cheap, standard lever.
- If gen-2 <= gen-1: record as negative; next suspects in order: depth 8-9 labels, mixing gen-1 + gen-2 data, SF19-MAX-labelled
  fine-tune (`nnue-finetune.yml`), king buckets (KB's CRN2, #57), larger H.

## Local verification of the gen-1 net (Agent IV, independent hardware)
Appended below when the local matches finish. 4 vCPU / 3.9 GB sandbox, SF19 official `sf_19` universal build, fastchess
1.8.3-alpha, same book hash. Labelled **preliminary** at these sample sizes.

### Result (EXP-IV0, preliminary, n = 100 per arm)
Same binary (`agentSD/selfdistill-on-ni` @ `41422e1`), same book (`f1d9e14283d1`), same seed (`-srand 4242`, so identical
openings in both arms), 10+0.1, Hash 64, 1 thread, SF19 `sf_19` universal build, fastchess 1.8.3-alpha, 4 vCPU / 3.9 GB
sandbox, 3 concurrent games. 0 illegal moves / time losses.

| arm vs SF19 `UCI_Elo 3000` | W-D-L | score | limiter-Elo [95% CI] |
|---|---|---|---|
| gen-1 net `a598bf2f3247` | 10-30-60 | 25.0% | -191 [-258, -134] |
| HCE (same binary, `UseNNUE=false`) | 3-30-67 | 18.0% | -263 [-335, -207] |

Reading: the direction agrees with SD1's gate (+123 vs HCE), and HCE's 18.0% matches KB's independent 18.75% on other
hardware. The 7-point difference is **not** resolved at n = 100 per arm (approx. LOS 90%): **inconclusive**, not a
confirmation. The distance to the owner's 80% target is still very large (roughly +400 limiter-Elo). **No 3000 claim.**
A planned local gen-1 vs HCE 3 x 60 gate was stopped after one partial replicate (n < 5): 60-game replicates add only about
+-75 Elo of noise on top of SD's 500 games. That is not a result.
